mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_log
AND event_cd = #{eventCd}

SELECT e.event_log_id::TEXT AS row_id, e.event_cd, c.name AS event_type_name, e.member_id, e.target_table, e.target_id, e.device_type, e.user_agent, e.reg_dt, e.reg_ip FROM event_log e LEFT JOIN code c ON c.code_id = e.event_cd AND c.p_code_id = 'EVENT00' WHERE e.event_log_id = #{rowId}::integer
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_log (event_cd, member_id, target_table, target_id, device_type, user_agent, reg_dt, reg_ip) VALUES (#{eventCd}, #{memberId}, #{targetTable}, #{targetId}, #{deviceType}, #{userAgent}, NOW(), #{regIp})
